text: Report says commuter rail service resumes tonight after strike talks.
evidence_text: Transit authority bulletin confirms trains restart at 8 PM.
Union and operator jointly announced a temporary agreement.

text: Headline claims the actor endorsed candidate Green at a rally.
evidence_text: Campaign office says no endorsement statement was issued.
The rally photo predates the current election cycle.

text: Neighborhood alert says a sinkhole closed Pine Street this morning.
evidence_text: Public works notice confirms Pine Street closure from 9 AM.
Traffic cameras show barricades at both entrances to the block.

text: Shared image claims voting was extended by two days nationwide.
evidence_text: Election commission states voting dates remain unchanged.
Notice in the graphic uses an unofficial seal and wrong hotline number.
